assumptions.coordinator_share_basis: lowest and highest measured in task stages of 10 or more agents (swarm/phase2/evidence/stages.json)
excluded: work the generated tasks do not stand in for
assumptions.pricing_basis: all input at the uncached input rate (cache discounts not applied: an upper bound)
assumptions.recipe: feature and mvp are swarm/phase3/economics.RECIPES 'one feature' and 'one system'; enterprise is 10 x 'one system'
assumptions.second_attempt_basis: low: measured failure share of the configurations used (factory); high: the worst measured failure rate of any stage of these sizes; a failed task is attempted once more at the same cost
assumptions.validity: the measured tasks are generated stand-ins (a function, a module-sized feature, a fix in an existing system), not product work; read the result as an order of magnitude for agent work of that shape, not as a quote for a real feature, MVP or enterprise system
assumptions.wall_time_basis: each size run in turn at the measured tasks per minute of its configuration (swarm/phase3/economics.project), not in parallel

cost_weights.about: Cost units weigh each kind of token against one uncached input token. The weights are the ratios of the published API prices (a cache read costs a tenth, a five-minute cache write a quarter more, a one-hour write double, an output token five times). They are an assumption for comparing configurations. They are not a measure of subscription allowance, which the host does not show.

development_lanes.note: each lane built one module of this repository with its tests: real development work, unlike the generated stand-in tasks

first_request_context_tokens.why: a host-reported size of a whole first request (host system prompt, tool schemas, connectors and the worker definition); it needs live agents on the host, so it cannot be re-measured offline. The part this tree controls is re-measured under context_footprint.
